summary: R02 continues to close owner-visible gaps with native proof. This slice implements the three contextual-sidebar controls the canonical range 4763-4866 requires and that did not exist: the header control that displays the selected Space and opens a Space switcher, the adjacent overflow control with that Space's quick actions (Manage / Rename / Archive), and collapse with an explicit rail expand control. Verified in the real apphost: header shows 'Switch Space' with the selected Space name; the switcher lists Chat/Study/Tasks/Assistants/Shopping/Research/Translate/Experiences; clicking the switcher's Open Translate row moved the same tab to 9to1://spaces/selected/b100...007/chat/9d4b0b45-6f73-4a6c-ab19-94fc02b760d7 and re-labelled the header; collapse removed the sidebar, kept the conversation and address, and left 'Expand this Space's sidebar' in the rail; expand restored it; overflow presented the three quick actions; WM_DELETE_WINDOW exited in 2s. Earlier in the session the same tab journey was proven for direct Space entry, the icon-only rail, the chat/history sidebar with real New chat and per-row conversation identities (including restoring an unsent draft), and the tab roundtrip that keeps the conversation and draft while another tab holds web content. Lane state: HavenOS.Spaces.Tests 219/219, CakeOS.Cui.Runtime.Tests 405/405, canonical CUI compilation 13/13, HavenOS.Apps.Browse.Tests 150/150, HavenOS.Browse.Host.Tests 254 passed / 3 failed (the 3 are the explicit 'requires actual Windows Home; Linux is unvalidated' platform guard). Remaining R02 gaps, recorded not hidden: the sidebar is not yet customisable through stable section/item/rule identities and Plugin-contributed custom sidebar elements with per-Space visibility are not implemented; the in-tab back control was disabled after a refused web navigation (open Haven browser-history question, entangled with the unavailable Gecko engine); the offline model-inventory native entry was not driven this pass.
next_action: Implement the stable section/item/rule sidebar customisation identity and Plugin-contributed sidebar elements with per-Space visibility (spec 4763-4866 and the Plugin sidebar acceptance section), then request independent acceptance for R01/R02 with the native evidence set.
